text: Reproduce and fix pak failure caused by neurosurf CRAN version reset 0.1.0.9004 -> 0.1.0. Accept >=0.1.0 and pin verified b8bb05d01dcf7360141850ad56b173d7df2f8079; keep dependency optional and native engine pin unchanged. Package-check (230 packages) and website (208 packages) lockfiles resolve. Built upstream neurosurf 0.1.0 in isolated library and validated all consumers: 3094 tests pass, 44 existing warnings, 2 opt-in skips; documentation/lint and 7 release guards pass; manual check 0 errors, 0 warnings, 3 environment/size notes; complete website builds including projection diagnostics, density demo and blink comparison. Publish review branch fix/neurosurf-release-requirement.
